theorems.statement: ∀ (ι : Type) [Countable ι] (b : ι → ℕ → ℝ) (M : ι → ℝ), (∀ k i, |b k i| ≤ M k) → ∃ σ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono σ ∧ ∀ k, ∃ L : ℝ, Tendsto (fun i => b k (σ i)) atTop (𝓝 L)
